title: Capabilities
help: What this agent can do. For what it can't, Floorbit falls back to what older agents do; updating the agent turns it on.

name.syslog_hold: Keeps other agents' syslog for a takeover

yes.lease: Polls and logs in only while Floorbit says it is the primary.
yes.split: Polls, logs in to and handles only its own devices.
yes.syslog_hold: Sends only its own devices' lines and keeps a minute of the rest.
yes.self_update: Installs the signed agent releases Floorbit offers, with no new image.

no.lease: Falls back to VRRP: the agent holding the first shared address is primary.
no.split: Falls back to one primary collecting every device of the group.
no.syslog_hold: Falls back to sending every line; Floorbit keeps each line once.
no.self_update: Falls back to the pull command: the crew pulls the new image by hand.
